text: Illustrate the story here: Chips and Dip Chuck and Rich are at lunch. Chuck has chips in his lunchbox but no dip. Rich has dip in his lunchbox but no chips. Chuck looks at Rich. Rich looks at Chuck. What can they do? Chuck dumps his chips on a dish. "Rich, do you want chips?" Chuck asks. "Yes I do!" said Rich. Rich slid his dip next to the dish. "Chuck, do you want dip?" Rich asks. "Yes I do!" said Chuck. They chill and chat and munch on chips and dip. Yum! Yum! Yum!
